findings.area: gate honesty / spec fidelity (FR-THM-001, FR-SCR-001; plan risks 1-2)
findings.detail: No row or leg checks that the SSR/CLI HTML inlines the content CSS (@layer fx.content) or the --fx-* theme variables; goldens and the first baseline would lock in unstyled output; the plan risk mitigations (CSS string module in ssr.ts, SSR-vs-browser parity per fixture) were dropped from the rows silently.
findings.failure_scenario: ssr.ts forgets the theme vars or content CSS; T1 passes in the browser, goldens and baseline record unstyled shapes, m4-complete goes green.

findings.detail: The staged ladder reaches 100-130 s under load against the 120 s budget; budget.json records 53.7 s; M4.11-M4.20 add Chromium T1, SSR, CLI build and e2e, and a mode-policy step; no row profiles or scopes the ladder.
findings.failure_scenario: From M4.11 every commit exceeds 120 s; the driver is pushed to raise the budget or skip the step.

findings.detail: m4-complete runs benches (~171 s), a core tzap run, two coverage runs, a build, pnpm verify and one vitest invocation per titled test (~20, 7 starting Chromium).
findings.failure_scenario: Late iterations on one red leg take 10-15 min each.

findings.detail: The 3 s-sampling p99 margin is not recorded; the command list lives in three places (CORE_COMMANDS, bench fixture COMMANDS, BENCH_COMMANDS hard-coded) and the bench-leg test builds its report from BENCH_COMMANDS.
findings.failure_scenario: A ninth built-in is never benched while the leg stays green.

findings.detail: The row and hand-off say the nightly job runs a diff-scoped tzap; it runs whole-package pnpm mutate --check (60 min timeout); neither row nor ADR reworded.
findings.failure_scenario: As pure packages grow the nightly job times out unnoticed.

findings.detail: e6ec407 is typed test(core) but simplifies production code in eight files (no behaviour change); the core floor is 100 % with no policy for a tzap upgrade that adds mutators.
findings.failure_scenario: A behaviour change hides in a test commit; a tzap bump turns the mutation leg red and a Threshold-change is argued in a hurry.

findings.detail: The determinism property generates update/delete/screen.delete/document.update/screen.reorder only, not element.create, screen.create or binding.set.
findings.failure_scenario: Nondeterminism local to binding.set or create is never exercised.

findings.detail: The demo leg checks validate, render, no script and two .fx-screen, not the plan content (rectangles, straight connectors, token styles).
findings.failure_scenario: A demo with two empty screens passes and CI uploads a blank R0 artifact.

findings.detail: architecture.test.mjs loads the TS 6 compiler API through createRequire(apps/docs/package.json).
findings.failure_scenario: A docs upgrade drops catalog:typescript6 from apps/docs and the test breaks loudly for an unrelated reason.

dispositions.note: M4.16: the HTML inlines the @layer fx.content CSS and the theme vars, every var(--fx-…) it uses is defined, and a T1 case shows SSR markup equals the browser render per fixture (plan risk 2); the gate names both titles.
Before M4.11: profile the staged ladder per step, scope what can be scoped, re-record budget.json; PRECOMMIT_BUDGET_MS unchanged.
Batch titled() into one vitest run per project.
BENCH_COMMANDS checked equal to CORE_COMMANDS ids and the bench fixture COMMANDS; record the 3 s p99 max in the ADR-0014 amendment.
ADR-0146 and the M4.3 wording say whole-package nightly runs; the timeout grows with the packages or the job splits per package.
ADR-0146 amendment: a tzap upgrade that adds mutators re-measures before raising or holding floors. The commit type is argued in review-argued.txt.
arbOps adds element.create, screen.create and binding.set.
Each demo screen has at least one shape .fx-el, one connector path, and uses a token style (var(--fx-…)).
The repo has one TS 6 pin, reached through apps/docs (ADR-0011); a failure there is loud, not a false green.

planDelta: 25 → 27 rows (+M4.26 ladder/gate speed and F1/F8 gate legs, +M4.27 bench list, determinism ops, ADR-0146 wording and floor policy); M4.16 and M4.22 acceptance amended; 27/18 = 1.5x, the growth being M3 hand-offs and review hardening, not product scope.
